_comment: Vendored copy of the governed lifecycle key-status vocabulary, so archive CI can check its enum against a declared authority without a lotus-platform checkout. Provenance is recorded by blob SHA rather than by path alone: a path says where it came from, a blob SHA says exactly what was copied, and only the second can be re-verified. See lotus-archive#147.
_scope: Only the status vocabulary is shared. The surrounding document is NOT archive's bundle: it describes a bank-controlled lifecycle authority (issuer const 'bank-lifecycle-governance'), forbids additional properties, and so forbids the 'provenance' field archive publishes and lotus-idea requires. Archive's bundle cannot and should not validate against it.
